title: Canonized Personality Spec
definition: A machine-readable representation of the Dr. Amanda Mistral's personality and characteristics.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine writing a character profile for a digital intelligence. This is a structured version of that profile, allowing for easier data processing and understanding.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Canonization of a personality specification involves transforming it into a structured format that allows for easy parsing and integration into machine learning pipelines.
difficulty_levels.expert: The canonization of the personality spec enables the application of symbolic AI techniques, such as rule-based systems and ontologies, while maintaining the flexibility and adaptability of machine learning methods.

extra_fields.insight: Canonizing the Spec allows for the preservation of the identity implant, while expanding coverage and sharpening boundaries.
